module: Flowgraph node "On Bigmap State Change" (category repeat_instant): detects the opening and closing of the big map. Pulse outputs: "enteredStart", "enteredEnd", "exitedStart", "exitedEnd" (start/end of transition).

onActivateBigMapCallback.desc: Hook: end of the map opening.

onBigmapStartTransition.desc: Hook: start of transition; activate true = enter, false = exit.

activate.desc: true if the big map opens, false if it closes.

esc.desc: Closing via the Escape key (inferred from code, unused).

onDeactivateBigMapCallback.desc: Hook: end of the map closing.

work.desc: Resets the pulses to false and applies the received flags.
